prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1119; do not mention it.)
text: This office has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by your insured's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment. Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We also request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page. Finally, we ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence related to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, claim notes, recorded statements, and any repair or salvage records. Please confirm in writing that these preservation steps have been taken. We look forward to your prompt response.
